integration.rootId: menu-live (one full-page shell per document in version 0.1)
integration.container: parent with container-name: ui-preview and container-type: inline-size
integration.mobileBreakpoint: 620 CSS px of supplied viewport, matching container query width
integration.icons: renderIcon(name) returns trusted SVG markup; no icon-package dependency
integration.content: DOM slots for header, breadcrumbs, actions, content and footer; reuse existing nodes
integration.routing: onNavigate(page); host calls select(page) and owns URL/history
integration.persistence: optional injected getItem/setItem storage and storageKey; no implicit localStorage access
